description: This Java class 'AuthorizeResponse' processes and interprets responses from the Authorize.Net payment gateway, providing methods to access response details such as transaction ID, response code, approval status, and other related fields.

classes.name: AuthorizeResponse
classes.description: Main class for handling and parsing Authorize.Net API responses, including methods to determine approval status and retrieve response fields.

classes.name: AuthorizeResponse.RespPositions
classes.description: Abstract class defining position retrieval for different response types.

methods.name: AuthorizeResponse
methods.description: Constructor initializing response parsing based on response string and type.

methods.name: isApproved
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates an approved transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionId
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction ID from the response.

methods.name: getAuthorizationCode
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization code from the response.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the transaction amount as BigDecimal.

methods.name: getResponseField
methods.description: Internal method to get a response field by name or position.
